summary.text: Brady Middleton is the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Democrat Abbie Groff-Blaszak.

paragraphs.text: Middleton advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
He previously ran in the 2014 Republican primary for Michigan House of Representatives District 73, receiving 393 votes (2.8%) in a seven-candidate field won by Chris Afendoulis.
According to Ballotpedia, his 2014 campaign website highlighted themes including jobs and the economy, road funding, veterans, and restorative justice.
